title: A Club for Short Stories
text:
Last year, a small library in our town started a short story club. Members meet once a month to discuss one story chosen by the group. At the first meeting, nobody wanted to speak, but the discussion became lively after the librarian asked a simple question about the ending.

Ania, who joined the club in the spring, now reads more carefully than before. She says that each story reveals something new when she reads it a second time. Her favourite story has an unreliable narrator, which made the group argue for an entire evening. She believes that a good short story leaves the reader with questions.

questions.text: How often does the club meet?
What made the group argue for an entire evening?
options: A story with an unreliable narrator

questions.text: Why did the discussion become lively at the first meeting?
options: The members had all read the story twice
The librarian's question encouraged people to share their ideas
A new member had just joined the club

questions.text: What can be inferred about Ania's view of short stories?
options: She thinks a story should answer every question
She values stories that keep the reader thinking
She prefers reading in complete silence
She believes short stories are always easy to understand

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who meet regularly around a shared interest
a conversation in which people share and compare their opinions
not trustworthy, so the reader cannot fully believe what is said
makes something known that was hidden before

paragraph_translations: W zeszłym roku mała biblioteka w naszym mieście założyła klub opowiadań. Członkowie spotykają się raz w miesiącu, aby omówić jedno opowiadanie wybrane przez grupę. Na pierwszym spotkaniu nikt nie chciał mówić, ale dyskusja ożywiła się, gdy bibliotekarka zadała proste pytanie o zakończenie.

Ania, która dołączyła do klubu wiosną, czyta teraz uważniej niż dawniej. Mówi, że każde opowiadanie ujawnia coś nowego, gdy czyta je po raz drugi. Jej ulubione opowiadanie ma niewiarygodnego narratora, co sprawiło, że grupa dyskutowała przez cały wieczór. Uważa, że dobre opowiadanie pozostawia czytelnika z pytaniami.
